permissions.moderate: Run the mural (roll back, ban painters, end seasons)

settings.widget: Show the live mural picture in the sidebar
settings.widget_help: A small picture of the canvas under the navigation. It hides itself on forums where you place the Mural widget with Bespoke or FoF Forum Widgets instead.
settings.allow_indexing: Let search engines index the mural pages
settings.allow_indexing_help: Off by default. The canvas itself needs JavaScript, so search engines see only the title and picture.
settings.cooldown_help: How long a member waits after placing a tile before they can place another. 300 is five minutes; 0 means no wait.
settings.group_cooldowns_help: Leave a group blank to use the wait above. A member in several groups gets the shortest wait of their groups.
settings.size_help: From 16 to 512 tiles a side. A new size takes effect when the next season starts; the canvas being painted keeps its size. 128 × 128 suits most forums; go bigger for busy ones.
settings.palette_help: {count} colors. The first one is the blank canvas. Like the size, a new palette takes effect at the next season.

page.title: Mural
page.description: One shared canvas the whole forum paints together, one tile at a time.
page.active: {count, plural, one {# painting now} other {# painting now}}

season.name: Season {number}
season.no_timelapse: This season's timelapse could not be loaded.

stage.label: The mural. Drag to move, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a tile to choose it. Arrow keys move the selection and Enter places a tile.

dock.hint_tile: Now tap the tile you want to paint.

mod.rollback_help: Puts the tiles in the area back to how they were before. Pick a member, a time range, or both. Nothing is deleted, so you can undo it below.
mod.area_help: Drag over the area you want to roll back.
mod.time_range: Only tiles placed in this time range
mod.preview: {count, plural, one {This undoes # tile} other {This undoes # tiles}} by {painters, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}.
mod.preview_none: No tiles match. Change the area, member or time range.
mod.rollback_go: {count, plural, one {Roll back # tile} other {Roll back # tiles}}
mod.rollback_done: {count, plural, one {Rolled back # tile.} other {Rolled back # tiles.}}
mod.undo_confirm: {count, plural, one {Put # tile back on the mural?} other {Put # tiles back on the mural?}}
mod.bans_help: A banned member can still look at the mural, but can't place tiles.
mod.ban_done: The member can no longer paint.
mod.end_help: {name} ends with {tiles} tiles. Its picture and timelapse go to the gallery, and everyone starts again on a blank canvas.
mod.end_go: End season and start the next
